shared: fresh process and empty managed expert cache per arm
activate S2 only at the prompt-to-generated-decode boundary
same prompt, seed, sampler, context, cap, capacity, stop, and scoring

capacity.conditions: three fresh n_ctx=7168 outcome-blind samples; native io_uring; zero buffered/synchronous fallbacks, I/O errors, swap, pressure failures, and terminal references

durability.github: no per-run comments; publish only material checkpoints
durability.pair_record: append/flush/fsync after both run checksums validate, then atomically replace pair summary and fsync parent directory
durability.raw_attempts: one immutable file per attempt containing token IDs, complete generated bytes, parsed thinking/response bytes, exit/stop identity, telemetry and checksum
durability.resume: skip only checksum-valid accepted records whose campaign, preregistration, project, nested, model, adapter, item, arm, seed, capacity and scoring identities all match; resume incomplete Stage-A S2 before advancing; never rerun S2 1..30
durability.run_record: append canonical JSONL after successful generation/scoring, flush and fsync outside inference timing, then atomically replace cumulative checkpoint and fsync parent directory

execution.stage_a: for pair 1..30 run EXACT, durably accept/score it, then S2 for the same item, then durably accept the pair
execution.stage_b: run S2 ordinals 31..198 only; reuse S2 1..30

disposition_order: QUALITY_LOWER_THAN_REFERENCE if point-reference <= -0.03 and Wilson upper < reference
QUALITY_HIGHER_THAN_REFERENCE if point-reference >= +0.03 and Wilson lower > reference
CONSISTENT_WITH_OFFICIAL_REFERENCE if reference is inside the inclusive Wilson interval and absolute point delta < 0.03
full_s2_statistics.fidelity_gate: NEAR_MATCH permits only the explicitly caveated disposition above; any protocol drift forces INCONCLUSIVE_PROTOCOL_OR_SAMPLE

generation.generation_seed: uint32 big-endian first four bytes of SHA-256(generation root NUL Record ID NUL repeat-0); paired arms share the identical seed
generation.stop: first llama_vocab_is_eog token or 4096 generated tokens; no string stop
generation.token_cap_outcome: accepted as truncated and scored incorrect; never rerun for quality

hard_resource_failures: any buffered or synchronous I/O fallback

harness.adapter_contract: repo-native implementation must reproduce the frozen manifest prompts, answer extraction, scoring, ordering, logging, resume identity, and arm boundary; exact implementation commit must receive independent pre-execution confirmation before scored inference

manifests.canonical_json: UTF-8, keys recursively sorted, ensure_ascii=false, compact separators, one trailing LF
manifests.choice_permutation: pinned simple-evals: Python random.Random(0), n_repeats=1, source CSV row order, rng.sample(range(4), 4) once per row
manifests.s2_order: the 30 pair IDs first, then every unselected ID in full-universe stable-hash order
manifests.selection: 10 items per high-level domain, ascending SHA-256(selection seed NUL domain NUL Record ID), tie by Record ID; pair order follows full-universe stable-hash order

official_reference.fidelity_reason: All published K3 controls are matched, but Moonshot does not publish the listed details; this campaign uses a pinned official GPQA source and pinned simple-evals semantics with one preregistered repeat.

bootstrap.draw_index: take digest bytes 0..7 of SHA-256(hash_input_bytes) as one unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer, modulo 30
bootstrap.draw_ordinals: zero-based integers 0..29 encoded as exactly two ASCII decimal digits (00..29)
bootstrap.hash_input_bytes: UTF-8 seed, one 0x00 byte, six replicate bytes, one 0x00 byte, two draw bytes
bootstrap.interval: nearest-rank two-sided 95% percentile interval; also report the one-sided 95% lower bound (5th percentile)
bootstrap.replicate_ordinals: zero-based integers 0..99999 encoded as exactly six ASCII decimal digits (000000..099999)

disposition_order: S2_GPQA_PAIRED_DEGRADED if delta <= -0.10 and two-sided 95% upper < 0
S2_GPQA_PAIRED_IMPROVED if delta >= +0.10 and two-sided 95% lower > 0
S2_GPQA_PAIRED_NO_MATERIAL_LOSS if not improved and one-sided 95% lower > -0.10
paired_statistics.secondary: exact two-sided McNemar binomial p-value over discordant pairs

pre_execution_gate: No scored GPQA inference until an independent reviewer verifies this preregistration and then confirms the exact adapter/project commit, nested commit, frozen manifests, capacity and non-scored conformance tests.

runtime_budget.exhaustion: halt for design review without changing order, protocol, capacity, or accepted evidence
runtime_budget.retry_identity: same item, arm, seed, protocol and attempt lineage; preserve every partial artifact; never select among completed outputs
runtime_budget.timeout_policy: a wall timeout is a technical failure and immediate halt, not an accepted truncated answer

scoring.channel: bytes after the first exact response boundary and before EOG; hidden thinking bytes are excluded
scoring.correct: extracted letter equals the manifest correct_answer_letter
scoring.denominator: all 30 accepted items per paired arm and all 198 accepted S2 items
scoring.invalid: missing response boundary, missing response text, or no regex match; accepted and scored incorrect
scoring.match: first regex match, as Python re.search in pinned simple-evals
scoring.truncated: accepted and scored incorrect even if a letter appears
